---
name: Beta feedback
about: Share one scan experience, including a scan with no problems.
title: "[Beta] "
---

Thanks for trying the desktop beta. Short answers are enough; use “none” or “not sure” where appropriate.

> This issue is public. Never upload private notes, a real vault, or sensitive vault contents. Remove private filenames, paths, link targets, names, and secrets from examples, error text, reports, and screenshots. Use a tiny made-up example instead. Do not paste an unreviewed Markdown report.

### Environment and scan

- Vault Doctor version:
- Obsidian version:
- OS/platform and version (Windows, macOS, Linux, or other):
- Approximate vault size (notes / attachments; rough estimates are fine):
- Excluded folders used? (yes/no; describe their purpose, not private paths):
- Scan completed? Overall status:
- Scan duration shown in the report (or where it stopped):
- Finding counts: broken links __ / missing attachments __ / orphan candidates __ / malformed frontmatter __
- Any scan errors or incomplete-reference warning?

### False positives

What was flagged but appears valid? How did you check it? Orphan candidates are not proof that an attachment is unused.

### Suspected missed problems

What did you expect to be flagged, and why? “None noticed” is useful too.

### Confusing UX/messages or performance issues

What was unclear, slow, or unresponsive? Include any installation difficulty; distinguish a slow scan from a slow report or copy action if possible.

### Reproduction information

If relevant, list the steps and a minimal invented file/link example. Say whether a second scan gives the same result. Link an existing bug issue instead of repeating it.

### Was it useful?

Did the report reveal something worth reviewing or save you work? Would you keep it installed for another scan, and why or why not?

### Optional screenshots

Only attach a cropped/redacted screenshot if it helps. Check note names, tabs, sidebars, paths, and visible content before uploading. No screenshot or vault upload is required.
